title: International Talents @unibo — Scholarships for International Students Enrolling in Second Cycle Degree Programmes
official_source: Alma Mater Studiorum – Università di Bologna
program_type: University merit and needs-based study grant for international students matriculating in a Second Cycle (Master's) degree programme
duration: Two academic years (a standard Second Cycle degree programme)
description: The University of Bologna awards 30 International Talents @unibo study grants each year to international students who matriculate for the first time in the first year of a Second Cycle (Laurea Magistrale) degree programme. Each grant is worth EUR 6,500 gross per academic year and is awarded for two academic years, and successful applicants also receive a full tuition fee waiver, paying only EUR 157.04 in regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium. title: Merit-Based International Scholarships — Politecnico di Milano (Academic Year 2027/2028)
program_type: University merit-based scholarship scheme for international Master of Science applicants, with Platinum, Gold, Bronze and Silver tiers plus partner-funded awards
duration: One academic year, renewable for a second year on academic points

title: Padua International Excellence Scholarship — Università degli Studi di Padova
program_type: University merit scholarship for international students enrolling in a completely English-taught degree programme: 2 years for master's degree programmes, 3 years for bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes
duration: 2 years for master's degree programmes; 3 years for bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes
description: The University of Padua awards up to 76 Padua International Excellence Scholarships each year to the most deserving international candidate on each degree programme delivered entirely in English. Each scholarship is worth EUR 8,000.00 gross per academic year plus full exemption from student fees, leaving only the regional right-to-education tax and the revenue stamp payable. There is no separate scholarship application: applying to an eligible English-taught degree programme by its admission deadline makes the candidate eligible automatically. title: UniTrento Scholarships for International Students (non-EU candidates residing abroad)
program_type: University merit scholarship awarded through the degree programme admission ranking, with a tuition-fee exemption; renewable on credit milestones
duration: Up to 2 years for a master's programme; up to 3 years for an undergraduate programme
description: The University of Trento awards a limited number of merit scholarships to citizens of countries outside the European Union who live outside Italy and enrol in a degree programme, based on their admission score and programme of study. The scholarship is worth EUR 7,200 per year, or EUR 8,500 per year for female students enrolled in STEM programmes, and scholarship holders are also exempted from paying tuition fees for that year. title: Bicocca International Scholarship Programme (BISP) — Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca
program_type: University merit scholarship for international students enrolling in English-taught degree programmes, awarded automatically through the admission ranking
duration: Up to 3 years for Bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes; up to 2 years for Master's degree programmes
description: The Bicocca International Scholarship Programme (BISP) is a merit award from the University of Milano-Bicocca for international students who hold a foreign qualification, are not resident in Italy and are admitted to one of the University's English-taught degree programmes. Around 100 scholarships are awarded each year, with five dedicated to each eligible English-taught course, mainly at Master's level. title: Talents 4 UniTo — Two-Year Scholarships for International Students Enrolling in English-Taught Master's Degrees (University of Turin)
program_type: University merit scholarship for international students enrolling in the first year of a postgraduate degree (Laurea Magistrale) without restricted access taught in English
duration: 2 years (two academic years), paid in four instalments of EUR 5,000 gross
description: Talents 4 UniTo is the University of Turin's programme of 40 two-year scholarships for talented international students enrolling for the first time in a postgraduate degree without a restricted number of places taught in English.
